How to enable on the desktop? · $ zcode --web --host 0.0.0.0

① Run zcode --web --host 0.0.0.0 [--port 3030] on the desktop; the terminal prints a tokenized link (http://<LAN-IP>:<port>/?token=…)\n② Phone and desktop must share the same LAN; Android has no local-network permission dialog — check hotspot/VPN isolation first on timeout\n③ The token ships with the link and is stored only in the app\'s private storage; for --no-token deployments (authRequired=false) it can stay empty
